subject: The one feature 90% of users skip (big mistake)
preview_text: We noticed you haven't unlocked the secret weapon yet. Here's why you're missing the most valuable insights.

That 'why' is the Confidence Score breakdown. It's not just a number. It shows you the *value*, not just the prediction. It's the difference between a hunch and a calculated insight.

Open the app right now. Pick any upcoming match and tap the Confidence Score. See the breakdown. That's where the real edge is. P.S. The users who check this before every match report a 73% higher satisfaction rate with their predictions. They're not guessing anymore.
